_description: Wasteland encounters surfaced during long-distance cardinal travel. After every N steps within the same macro location, the engine rolls against this pool. Each archetype declares: matchers (biome / location tags it fires in), narration template ({biome}, {direction} substituted), optional loot drop with material kinds, optional NPC dialogue, optional follow-up hook the player can chase. Adding a new encounter type is a JSON edit, no engine code. Drives the 'walking is enjoyable' goal — player feedback: 'walking into the desert and finding an old bus with a note in it that tells you a direction to travel and to look for a rock... a body with a sad story and a small keepsake. Layer those up every 2 or 3 movements and you can make the world massive.'

abandoned_caravan.narration: You crest a low rise and a Reclaimer caravan slumps in the silt — axle snapped, banner half-buried. Whoever drove it left in a hurry, or didn't leave at all.
abandoned_caravan.lore_note: A note tucked under the bench reads: 'East three days, the Pillars. We didn't make it.'

frozen_traveller.narration: A body sits cross-legged in the silt, mud-glassed in place. The pose is patient. Whatever they were waiting for never arrived.
frozen_traveller.lore_note: A locket on their chest holds a pre-flood photograph — a face you don't recognise, smiling at a sky that doesn't exist anymore.

wandering_drifter.narration: A figure trudges toward you across the silt — staff, mud-cloak, eyes that have been further than yours.
npc_lines: "There's a buried gate two days east," the drifter says, not stopping. "I wouldn't open it."
"You're newer than the last one I passed. They didn't make it either."
"The Aether's loud tonight. I'd rest if I were you."
"Mud Monarchs running patrols north of here. Step careful or step around."
"The flats remember every step. Walk like you mean it."

scavenger_camp.narration: Smoke first, then voices. Two scavengers crouched around a hooded brazier, sorting what looked like brass fittings and pre-flood wire.
npc_lines: "You want a fitting? Two coin. You want both? Three coin and don't look at the third pile."
"Heard there's a body in a wagon south of here. We don't go south."
"Aether's been thick all week. Anything mechanical is half-junk by morning."

skirmish_pack.narration: Movement low and fast — a {enemy} cuts across your path. You're closer than either of you wanted to be.

fungal_patch.narration: A patch of luminous fungus grows in a low pocket of mud. Three colours: pale blue at the centre, copper-orange at the rim, deep violet under the wettest spots.
fungal_patch.lore_note: Halem the Trader pays for fungi by the colour. Blue for clarity. Orange for fire. Violet for the dreaming road.

old_bus_with_note.narration: Pre-flood transport, gutted and tipped onto its side. The destination scroll above the driver's seat still reads 'OUTER LINE — DRAKOVA.' Inside, a duffel bag sits propped against the back wheel-well. A note pinned to the bag.
old_bus_with_note.lore_note: Note reads: 'If you find this, keep walking east. Three days, look for the standing stone — the one with the chip on its crown. There's something buried at its base. I never made it back.'

still_with_alcohol.narration: A makeshift still — copper coil, clay vessel, charred wood. Whoever ran it abandoned the rig but left two sealed jugs in the shade.
still_with_alcohol.lore_note: A tin cup hangs from a nail. The owner's name is scratched into the bottom: 'YORK — DON'T DRINK THE VIOLET.'

etheric_storm_debris.narration: An Aetheric storm passed through here recently. The ground is scattered with small fused chunks of mud-glass and the still-warm remains of something pre-flood that the storm pulled out of the earth.
